title: Blood, Sweat and Tears
overview: Young teenager Matthew Rush finds himself on the lowest team his school has for rugby, the C subs. As well as that, an almost fail grade of forty-eight percent in his maths test. The only way he can improve in academics and sports is by working harder than he ever has before.

trailers.title: Blood, Sweat and Tears – Award-Winning Short Film (2017)
